headlines.title: 14 ETFs Add to ASML (ASML) Holdings on Nov. 5
headlines.summary: ETFs bought $28.9 million of ASML shares on Thursday.

headlines.title: Why ASML Holdings Fell in October
headlines.summary: A big earnings beat wasn't enough to offset broader fears that drove the AI stock sell-off last month and into November.

headlines.title: ASML Stock In Focus As EUV Machine Orders Stretch Into 2030
headlines.summary: ASML Holding is seeing orders for its advanced EUV lithography systems stretch into 2029 and 2030, with demand already above planned capacity for 2027 and 2028 as chipmakers secure tools critical for AI focused semiconductor production. In parallel with this long dated order book, ETF flows show continued institutional interest in ASML even as the stock recently declined amid broader chip sector weakness and questions around future data center and AI spending.

headlines.title: NVIDIA, AMD, TSMC And ASML Are His Semiconductor Picks
headlines.summary: James Demmert, chief investment officer at Main Street Research, sees value in AI but draws a sharp line between dominant operators with existing data centers and companies still racing to build them.

headlines.title: ASML Sinks 8% as Post-Election Chip Rout Deepens
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysASML shares fell 8% today in a post-election chip sell-off, and Everpure fell even harder. ASML had no news, and its customers’ down payments show demand for its machines still outruns supply.

description: ASML Holding N.V. provides lithography solutions for the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading, and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. The company offers lithography, metrology, and inspection systems. It also provides extreme ultraviolet lithography systems; and deep ultraviolet lithography systems comprising immersion and dry lithography systems solutions to manufacture various range of semiconductor nodes and technologies. In addition, the company offers metrology and inspection systems, including YieldStar optical metrology systems, a diffraction-based wafer metrology platform to assess the quality of patterns on the wafers; and HMI electron beam solutions to locate and analyze individual chip defects. Further, it provides computational lithography solutions, and lithography systems and control software solutions; and refurbishes and upgrades lithography systems, as well as offers customer support and related services. Additionally, the company offers hardware, software, and services to chipmakers to produce the patterns of integrated circuits. It operates in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China, rest of Asia, the Netherlands, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the United States. The company was formerly known as ASM Lithography Holding N.V. and changed its name to ASML Holding N.V. in 2001. ASML Holding N.V. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
